notes.title: Love Letter official launch !
notes.content:
Hello romantic players , 

It is time to send your Love letter to the princess and hope to conquer her heart. 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33620620/a6ab7d327b722a80be436693348506d480e2b74d.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33620620/db30922d8c09cd5331eaef824dde6a950177d0af.jpg[/img][/url]

The game is now available on Steam including all these features : 

- Tutorial
- Single player mode
- Online Multiplayer, Public and Private. 
- Leaderboard
- Asmodee account connectivity

Enjoy the game !


https://store.steampowered.com/app/926520/
